item.title: Queensland moves to centralise child safeguarding under new Protection Commission
item.description: Queensland has introduced legislation to establish a central safeguarding authority responsible for the Reportable Conduct Scheme, Blue Card system and disability worker screening, with stronger information-sharing powers and increased penalties for organisations that fail to meet key reporting obligations.

item.title: Generational Gold Coast childcare asset hits the market
item.description: A premium childcare investment occupied by leading privately-owned operator Kool Beanz has been launched to the market, offering investors the opportunity to acquire a long-term leased early education asset in one of Queensland's most affluent residential catchments.

item.title: National guidance puts child safety at centre of ECEC building design
item.description: New national guidance is calling for child safety, effective supervision and children’s rights to be considered from the earliest stages of education and care service design, with practical examples showing how the physical environment can reduce risks to children.

item.description: Service gaps, workforce pressures and whether the Child Care Subsidy is meeting the needs of families and providers outside metropolitan areas will come under scrutiny in a new Senate inquiry into early childhood education and care across rural, regional and remote Australia.
